name: neutral-facing
description: bugs.md 'Gold mine / neutral building orientation': gold mines, taverns and goblin merchants of Neutral Passive, Player 1's barracks and footmen at 0, 0.5, 90 degrees, 3.0 and 5.5 radians and the whole number 2.0 (make-neutral-facing.mjs); the editor opens the map and saves it.
